name: DRAM 5700
title: Studies in Professional Acting
description: Topics and skills not taught in DRAM 5701-5706.  May include work with the techniques of specific master acting teachers such as (but not limited to) Sanford Meisner, Stella Adler, Tadashi Suzuki, and Utah Hagan. May be repeated with change of topic. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
